blinding: Reviewer service serves raw RGB and the current role annotations only. No candidate outputs, source masks, scores or inferred contact status are served.
source_failure_audit: Separate phase after reference adjudication is hash-locked; source overlays never establish the reference.
contact_scope: Visible native-image boundaries and projected separation; physical contact is separately judged and may remain unknown. No hidden-boundary or depth inference.
motion_scope: Fixed physical landmark through time; never a moving visible-mask centroid. Manual events are time intervals, not forced exact instants.
sampling: Browse all native frames. Aim for anchors every 40 ms in motion episodes; record invisibility rather than interpolate. Review a pilot before scaling.
prior_exposure_policy: Record prior candidate exposure per case. Raw-only service blinding does not erase prior familiarity; reviewer B should be independently naive.
